objective: Create the platform repository skeleton described by the P0.2 design of the guide repository. Revised five times after independent peer review. Round five closed the two things the previous four could not: mutation coverage was not measurable, and no record was bound to a human identity.
completed_scope: One pnpm workspace with the top-level layout the P0.2 design draws, 30 modules registered, 4 with packages whose every exported function throws

The seven dependency rules generated from modules/modules.yaml, stamped with the registry SHA-256 and compared by --check; both arms of rules 5 and 5b now witnessed, including the apps/ side that a review loosened with the suite staying green

scripts/migration-lint.mjs: a SINGLE-PASS scanner, deny-by-default on any statement whose leading verb is not provably harmless, and refusal of what it cannot represent - a quoted identifier outside [A-Za-z0-9_], a non-ASCII character in an unquoted one, a dollar-quoted body, a single-quoted function body, and a psql meta-command

M1 covers the statements that move or bind data across a schema: the DML verbs, COPY, MERGE, REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW, LOCK, ANALYZE, VACUUM, REINDEX, CLUSTER, SELECT INTO, the comma-separated list forms, FROM/JOIN/USING/PARTITION OF/INHERITS/LIKE, ALTER ... INHERIT and ATTACH PARTITION, a schema-qualified call in DEFAULT or CHECK position, a type in cast position, and a type in DECLARATION position

Any statement that can change schema resolution is refused whatever its spelling: SET search_path in every form, SET SCHEMA quoted or bare, and any set_config() call, whose argument this lint deliberately does not try to read (DEC-023)

M4 and M5 gate on a SET of table-creating verbs - CREATE TABLE, CREATE FOREIGN TABLE, CREATE VIEW, CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW, SELECT INTO - and the RENAME TO destination is a target for every renameable relation kind, not only ALTER TABLE
M3 refuses its four verbs, a column drop and a column type change across every relation kind, not only the literal ALTER TABLE spelling

scripts/validate_continuity.py: strict readers whose DEFAULT IS AN ERROR over authority.yaml, gates.yaml, skills.yaml and agents.yaml; closed status enums; expires_at enforced against the record date; the state-registry relation total in both directions; the acceptance transition pinned in lifecycle.yaml; a Work Package unable to enter ACCEPTED ahead of its acceptance grant; the skills floor pinned two ways; every seat's held_by pinned to null; and the governance routing pinned to seats no agent may occupy

scripts/coverage-gate.mjs: a protection this repository NAMES must be witnessed by a fixture asserting its message, derived from the code rather than a list kept beside it. Its seam is a command-line argument, not an environment variable, because an environment variable neutered the gate and all four of its own witnesses at once (DEC-026)
scripts/generate-codeowners.mjs generating .github/CODEOWNERS from the routing block, with a --check mode in pnpm verify and CI

No test suite writes a tracked file. The boundary suite works on a copy; the mutation check runs against a disposable git worktree, aborts on a dirty tree and fails the run if it dirties one; orphaned worktrees are reclaimed by owner-pid. A recorded PASS is reproducible by construction (DEC-024)
98 mutations, 74 violating migration fixtures, 127 boundary tests, 79 validator tests

scripts/mutation-attribution.mjs and the attribution gate: every mutation declares the control that must catch it, an anchor matching twice is refused, a mutation caught by anything other than its declared witness fails the run, and the mutation-to-control overlap is printed in both directions with the count of mutations no control kills alone (DEC-027)

badf/signing-policy.yaml, scripts/signing-policy.mjs and scripts/check-signing.mjs: commit-signature verification over eight governed paths, reporting SIGNING_CHECK NOT_ENFORCED while no key is enrolled, with PASS structurally unreachable in that state and a control asserting its absence (DEC-028)

Every git invocation in the signing check passes --no-replace-objects, and a shallow history is refused before any commit is resolved. Both were demonstrated false-PASS bypasses before they were closed (DEC-029)
175 boundary controls, 9 signing controls, 94 validator controls, 154 mutations, 16 coverage-gate protections; pnpm verify runs twelve checks

assumptions: ASSUMED: the modular monolith of ARCH-001 section 4.1, with the seven dependency rules and one schema per module. ADR-001 decides this and is DRAFT_REQUIRED.
ASSUMED: the candidate modules of the ARCH-001 capability map are the registry entries. Whether each is a bounded context, a subdomain or an aggregate is BIZTRUST-DOMAIN-001's decision.
ASSUMED: dependency-cruiser as the checker. The rules are generated, so a different checker consumes the same registry.
ASSUMED: the migration lint is a deterministic script under scripts/, per P0.2 open question 5. It is a text check over SQL and its blind spots are listed under declared_non_coverage.
ASSUMED: PostgreSQL's documented grammar for the statements the lint refuses. No database exists here, so no refusal has been confirmed against a running server.
ASSUMED: GitHub as the host. Branch protection is now observed rather than assumed.
blockers: BT-G0 is unrecorded. ARCH-001 is a draft, and FOUNDATION_SEQUENCE.md slice S01 needs five human review seats that are unfilled. No P0 epic may be implemented until an architecture authority records it.
ADR-001, ADR-004, ADR-005, ADR-010 and ADR-011 are all DRAFT_REQUIRED. The rules in this repository are the proposal of a design at IN_REVIEW.

NS-001 is half done. Branch protection is applied and negative control 6 is observed, but the repository-administrator seat is unfilled. badf/agents.yaml now records held_by: null for every seat and refuses any other value, so filling one is a reviewed change to the validator under a Work Package - which is the cost a human decision should carry, and which no agent may pay on a human's behalf.
Peer review has returned REVISION_REQUIRED five times. Every reviewer has been an agent. None is the independent human verifier the P0.2 design names, and no re-review of this head has happened.
authority_status: The scaffold was built under a direct operator instruction, recorded in badf/authority.yaml under granted.repository_scaffold. That is an operator instruction recorded by an agent; it is NOT the expiring implementation grant from a business authority seat that the P0.2 design requires. Every other authority in that file is NOT_GRANTED, wp_001_acceptance included. Round four hardened the registries around it: the skills floor is pinned two ways, the four human seats cannot be made agent-occupiable, every seat's held_by must be null, and the governance paths route only to seats no agent may occupy. What none of this establishes is that any record here was written by a human. A forgery that edits all three records consistently still passes, and the only mechanism that addresses it is the approval requirement now enforced on main.
next_action: Break the seat-bootstrap loop, then fill the repository administrator seat. docs/decisions/PROPOSAL-bootstrap-seating.md costs four ways and recommends one; no agent may adopt any of them. The DEC-029 precondition on enrolling a signing key is discharged - DEC-030 closed the grafts vector - so seating is now the only thing in the way.
recovery: Read AGENTS.md, then badf/authority.yaml, then badf/current-state.json and badf/next-actions.json. The branch is motor/p0.2/repository-and-boundaries off 062a0f7c1b350e4af695978b238b28e323b7d0e0 on main, and pull request #1 tracks it. First safe command: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, then pnpm verify, which runs the ten checks above in order. All ten were observed at this head with the exit statuses recorded. If any fails, the tree has diverged from this checkpoint and the answer is RECOVERY_REQUIRED, not a fix. The suites no longer write tracked files, so a run leaves the tree byte-identical; if it does not, that is itself the finding.
declared_non_coverage: OPEN GOVERNANCE DEFECT, recorded not resolved. badf/agents.yaml routes changes to itself with verifier: repository-administrator, so filling that seat requires the seat to verify its own creation. The same unfilled seat owns badf/signing-policy.yaml and AGENTS.md, so enrolling the first signing key and amending the charter are blocked behind the same loop. An agent may not resolve it - a rule deciding who may seat an authority is a larger act than any grant it is already forbidden to make. Four options are costed at docs/decisions/PROPOSAL-bootstrap-seating.md and none is adopted. DEC-032.

THE ONE THAT MATTERS MOST, unchanged by this round. A forgery that edits badf/authority.yaml, badf/current-state.json and the checkpoint CONSISTENTLY passes every check here. Nothing binds a record to a human identity, and no validator can close that. The mechanism that addresses it is the approval requirement on main, recorded under NS-001.

A REVIEW THAT READS EACH CHANGE IN ISOLATION CANNOT FIND THE WORST CLASS. Round four found that a later change had silently narrowed an earlier change's deny-by-default, and no per-task review could have seen it - only reading the six changes together did. This is stated as a limit of the review method, not of any instrument.

CODEOWNERS is generated and checked for drift, but it is NOT a working control. It needs GitHub's require-review-from-code-owners setting enabled, and the named @bstBizEra/<role> teams to exist and be populated. Both are human acts. A reader must not mistake the file's presence for routing being enforced.

The migration lint is a text check over SQL, not a parser. It refuses what it cannot read rather than passing it, but it cannot see dynamic SQL built at runtime, or an extension that creates objects as a side effect.

No refusal has been confirmed against a running PostgreSQL server. The grammars refused - SET SCHEMA 'value' as a search_path alias, ALTER ... INHERIT, ATTACH PARTITION - are taken from documentation. There is no database here.

The coverage gate enumerates 16 named protections: the four audit verbs, the four domain stems and the eight rule families. It does NOT enumerate TABLE_CREATING_VERBS, CROSS_SCHEMA_READ_KEYWORDS, FORBIDDEN_TO_AGENTS_SKILLS or AGENT_FORBIDDEN_ROLES. Those four lists are witnessed per entry by fixtures and mutations, but adding an entry to one of them without a fixture would not fail the gate.

reclaimOrphanWorktrees is witnessed for reclaiming a dead run's worktree but not for leaving a LIVE sibling's alone; and a worktree orphaned under a test-only tag prefix is not reclaimed by any normal run.
tests/boundaries/real-root-lock.mjs has stale-lock risk if a holder is killed, bounded by a 60s timeout and a self-diagnosing error. Test-only; it does not compound per interruption.

CODEOWNERS_TEST_OUT remains an environment-reachable seam in scripts/generate-codeowners.mjs. It fails closed and the byte-identity test reads the real path in-process, so the property stays witnessed - but it is not the argument-only shape DEC-026 chose for the coverage gate.
ALTER TABLE t ALTER COLUMN a SET DATA TYPE pg_catalog.numeric(12,2) is falsely reported by the expression-call scan reading a typmod as a call. Fails closed.

M4's stems match as a prefix of an underscore-separated part, so a compound like insurancepolicy passes. A declared design decision (DEC-013), recorded here because it was previously only in the code.
M5 tests for tenant_id anywhere in the statement, so a view or a table whose only occurrence is in a REFERENCES clause satisfies it without exposing the column.

Two double-reports and one clause mislabel remain: VACUUM ANALYZE, a nested fixture matched by both the DML and FROM scans, and LIKE matching the pattern-match operator as well as the table-copy clause. All fail closed.
BEGIN and COMMIT are refused by deny-by-default. Deliberate: a migration runner owns transaction control, not a migration.
Negative control 6 is observed; every OTHER runtime control is not. Nothing runs: there is no server, no database and no configuration.
Rule 7's outbound host allow-list does not exist, and apps/ outside the fixture workspace contains only a README.
The contract lint over openapi/ and events/ (P0.8, P0.9), the observability tests (P0.11), and the security proof suite over tests/security/ (needs BT-G0).
No fixture proves the typecheck fails, so the compiler is an unwitnessed instrument.
Rules 1 and 2 are generated per module; the fixture exercises one instance of each family, and the coverage gate deliberately asks for families rather than instances.
The design's control 7 says the boundary check's GENERATION step catches a package with no registry row. It does not; a separate script does.

The signing check is DETECTION, not prevention, and nothing mechanically distinguishes a human enrolment from an agent one - any check the agent can edit is a check the agent can edit. Only required_signatures branch protection on main converts it into a binding, and that is a human act on GitHub, outside this repository.

42 of 154 mutations are killed by no control alone. The attribution gate refuses a mutation caught by a control OTHER than the one it declares, and refuses two mutations whose killer sets are identical, but it does not refuse a declared witness that is a strict SUPERSET of the control which actually discriminates. That population is reported rather than gated, deliberately: gating it would force a contrived fixture for every genuinely broad guard.

The NOT_ENFORCED message says two of the three human acts are 'named nowhere in this repository as forbidden to an agent'. badf/authority.yaml records main_branch_protection as held by a repository administrator, a human role, so the claim overreaches. The narrower claim it makes about badf/skills.yaml is exact.

The coverage gate enumerates 16 named protections and does not enumerate PINNED_PROTECTED_PATHS, ACCEPTED_KEY_RULES, SIGNING_KEY_KINDS, VERDICT_TERMS, TABLE_CREATING_VERBS or CROSS_SCHEMA_READ_KEYWORDS. Each entry in those six is witnessed per entry by a fixture and a mutation, but adding an entry to one without a fixture would not fail the gate.
scripts/validate_continuity.py now carries 23 mutations; scripts/registry.mjs, scripts/check-module-packages.mjs, scripts/generate-codeowners.mjs and the --overlap presentation flag carry none.

The real-signature PASS path - a commit whose %G? is G from an accepted identity - is witnessed by classifyCommit fixtures and was driven end to end by a reviewer with a throwaway SSH key, but no test in this repository creates key material, so it is not witnessed by the suite. %GS rendering for a GPG rather than SSH key is untested.
tests/boundaries/real-root-lock.mjs has no stale-lock recovery, unlike the worktree reclamation beside it. A killed suite run leaves a lock that costs the next run a 60s timeout on four controls.
